items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: He had a lot of good musicians, but they were string instruments. Mark Hawkins, Forrest Hawkins, Bubba Quirk, Walter, and the gang

ctx.x: Well, this one he played a mandolin. And he was a wonderful singer. He had a lot of good musicians, but they were string instruments. Mark Hawkins, Forrest Hawkins, Bubba Quirk, Walter, and the gang, you know, they all played the bandolons, guitars, and the first one thing I liked.
It wouldn't have been Little Walters up here at the Harmonic. Not this one, no. You played, you said, in Natchez too, a while? Oh, yeah.
